searchText: etherchain used to show block tip+mev found and I don't see it anymore. Is there a website that shows this on one page? It was wrong 90% of the time btw It's still right there on beaconcha.in? They just rely on the values reported by the relays themselves, so I doubt it is wrong that often ( for example, https://beaconcha.in/slot/5414391 -> https://boost-relay.flashbots.net/relay/v1/data/bidtraces/proposer_payload_delivered?slot=5414391 ) nope, not one that is accurate. the complete opposite -- the mev overview on etherchain was mostly incorrect and was solely based on internal transactions to the pool but etherchain.org will be shutdown soonTM as we move everything over to beaconcha.in and open source it. Ah, then I totally misunderstood <@636289909359116290> 's question. I wasn't aware of Etherchain showing any such data (I guess also prior to the merge?), only of Beaconcha.in doing it post-merge for the MEV-Boost/relay stuff. it was this subpage <http://web.archive.org/web/20220819112416/https://etherchain.org/miner> which is similar to <https://beaconcha.in/pools> and <https://beaconcha.in/relays> imo, MEV is less wild nowadays, as there are only 2 big block builders and validators can plug in all relays and pick the most profitable Ty for the responses.
